text: Alatau City Bank (formerly Jusan Bank) is controlled by Kazakh businessman Vyacheslav Kim, whom press name as the bank's sole shareholder; press also report he completed the bank's purchase in July 2025.
short: Alatau City Bank is owned by businessman Vyacheslav Kim, named by press as its sole shareholder.

source.name: Exclusive.kz — Миллиардер, совладелец крупного банка создал холдинговую компанию в МФЦА
source.quote: совладелец Kaspi.kz и единственный акционер Alatau City Bank Вячеслав Ким зарегистрировал в Международном финансовом центре «Астана» новую холдинговую компанию
source.note: Translation: 'Kaspi.kz co-owner and sole shareholder of Alatau City Bank Vyacheslav Kim registered a new holding company in the Astana International Financial Centre.' A second article (Kursiv.kz, 23 Feb 2026, kz.kursiv.media/2026-02-23/fvfv-vladelec-alatau-city-bank-smenit-imya/) reports Kim completed the purchase of the former Jusan Bank through taking control of its parent First Heartland Securities in July 2025; that page serves scripts a version without the article text, so it is linked here from the note only.
